description: Defines the ScreenPermission entity class with properties and methods for managing permissions related to screens and user roles in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ScreenPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions for screens associated with user roles, including read, create, update, and delete permissions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen entity with this permission.
